Renew-ready party

  • Sun, Dec 13 · 2 to 4 pm
  • Central Winds Park, Winter Springs · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
ERV+3538 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Asked for a mail ballot before Nov 3? That request ends Dec 31. Ask again and you should be set through 2028. Check My Voter Record to be sure.

What's the plan

Snacks, music, lawn games and a table of people who know this stuff. Bring your phone: we'll help you look up your voter record, fix your address if you've moved, find the one number you'll need, and ask for your mail ballot again on the official site, yourself. Seminole hasn't posted how it handles requests made before New Year's, so set a reminder to check My Voter Record in January and make sure yours shows.

You do everything yourself on the official site. We never take forms or personal information.

Getting in

We'll be under a covered pavilion (we'll post which one). Extra folding chairs, a shady spot to sit, and kids are welcome.

What to bring

  • Your phone
  • Know where your Florida driver license or ID card is: you'll need its number (or the last 4 of your Social Security number) to renew
  • A blanket or a folding chair
  • A friend whose request runs out too

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • Florida vote-by-mail requests made before the Nov 3, 2026 general election end Dec 31, 2026 (one request lasts through the end of the year of the next regular general election).

    Source: flsenate.gov

  • In-person and phone requests need the voter's Florida driver license number, Florida ID card number or the last four digits of their Social Security number, whichever the Supervisor of Elections can verify. Seminole's online request form asks for the same.

    Source: flsenate.gov

  • Under the state's rule, a mail-ballot request made after the Nov 3, 2026 general election should last through 2028. Seminole's Supervisor of Elections hasn't posted how it handles requests made Nov 4 to Dec 31, 2026, so check My Voter Record in January (or call 407-585-8683) to make sure yours shows.

    Source: flsenate.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
